getting-over-it.title: Getting Over It - Free Online Physics-Based Climbing Game
getting-over-it.slogan: Climb, Struggle, and Overcome in Getting Over It
getting-over-it.description: Getting Over It is a thrilling physics-based climbing game where you navigate a cat in a plant pot up a mountain of colorful blocks and enormous fruits. Master the hammer mechanics to climb higher and higher, but beware—it's incredibly challenging! Getting Over It offers a unique blend of strategy and skill, pushing you to your limits. Ready to take on the challenge? Play Getting Over It now and see how far you can go!

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Getting Over It - Climb Your Way to the Top
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Getting Over It is a fan-made game inspired by the original Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy. In this version, you play as a cat in a plant pot, climbing a mountain of colorful blocks and enormous fruits using a hammer.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the mouse to control the hammer and climb the mountain.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Navigate through colorful blocks and enormous fruits.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Reach the highest point in the game to win.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Master the hammer mechanics to climb the mountain.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Play as a cat in a plant pot, climbing colorful blocks and enormous fruits.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: The game gets harder as you climb higher.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Navigate through a surreal and challenging landscape.
